title: Village Road Repair
description: Repairing the main road connecting the village to the highway. This includes filling potholes, laying a new asphalt layer, and improving drainage on both sides of the road to prevent waterlogging during monsoons.

title: New Community Hall
description: Construction of a new multi-purpose community hall for village gatherings, festivals, and educational workshops. The hall will feature a stage, seating for 300 people, and basic amenities.

title: Solar Street Lights
description: Installation of 50 energy-efficient solar-powered street lights across the village to improve safety and visibility during the night. These lights are equipped with automatic sensors.
